items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: Either that or like the Banana Man you know, from Captain Kangaroo.

ctx.x: Normally I would say a list of what musicians do and what their gig is, but because you’re a guy who works with words a lot, I’m going to offer you a chance to introduce what your life’s work has been.

Wow. Okay. I am, for lack of a better word, a free-lance trumpeter, primarily a jazz trumpeter who also is able and does a lot of work writing. And that extends into some other activities which sort of is a logical progression, sort of like the 2-5-1 of life. But that kind of moved into consulting, production consulting and creative consulting and other things, book consulting. It’s kind of like someone said to me one time, “What is it that you do?” So I says, “I’m kind of like Monty Rock III from the old…

Would you think, would all those dominoes have started and fallen into place if you hadn’t been a player first? And what I mean by that is sometimes I’m fascinated by people who are tremendous fans of the music or they make a living as perhaps a jazz journalists but they weren’t players first. So did your trumpet playing lead to all these things?
